angularDiameterSource: Limb-darkened angular diameter 20.58 ± 0.03 mas, or 44.2 ± 0.9 solar radii, from lunar occultations and VLTI/VINCI by Richichi and Roccatagliata (2005), A&A 433, 305.
distanceSource: Inverse of the Hipparcos new-reduction parallax 48.94 ± 0.77 mas (van Leeuwen 2007) via SIMBAD
radiusSource: Radius: Limb-darkened angular diameter 20.58 ± 0.03 mas, or 44.2 ± 0.9 solar radii, from lunar occultations and VLTI/VINCI by Richichi and Roccatagliata (2005), A&A 433, 305. Adopted 30,749,940 km, 44.2000 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius. No gravitational parameter is adopted. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is adopted.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Effective temperature 3934 ± 41 K from Richichi & Roccatagliata 2005 (A&A 433, 305; https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361:20041765), Section 4: the lunar-occultation and VLTI/VINCI diameter with the bolometric flux.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius in the shared neutral gray; no picture of the photosphere is cast.
